text:
In the first scene, I feel a sense of quiet anticipation. The nearly empty conference room behind glass feels like a place awaiting ideas or conversation, yet there is an underlying loneliness to its order and silence. I am aware of my own presence and the slight displacement created by the tilted angle.

In the second scene, faced with the vibrant R+D wall, I feel invigorated and curious. Here, the bold colors and the intellectual promise of innovation stir my thoughts. I sense the forward motion of human creativity and inquiry—a sharp contrast to the solitude felt moments ago. The world pulses with questions and discoveries, and I am part of the questioning.
